scope: Read-only replay of 30 paper-suite checkpoints and five WOT ablations. Historical scores are distinct from converged-OT diagnostics and from training from scratch.
selection: Recovered checkpoint/log/config correspondence; selected earlier Ocean and iPSC2 checkpoints when later directory contents had changed. No new training or holdout hyperparameter tuning in this recovery.
protocol: 101-point observed-anchor Euler grid; all configured frame samples; seeded data selection and training-only standardization; MMD, W1, W2. Historical OT uses the inherited 100000 iteration limit.
